topic: Planning and Reasoning in Large Language Model Agents: Methods, Tool Use, and Evaluation Benchmarks

per_sentence.text: Li et al. (2024) note that their survey is the first to comprehensively analyze LLM-based agents specifically through the lens of planning abilities.

per_sentence.text: For large language models, chain-of-thought reasoning approaches assist the model in generating textual explanations, and recent work has further sought to enhance chain-of-thought reasoning to make the process more robust and reliable (Li et al., 2024).
